value.drug_or_class: Plasma Exchange, Plasmapheresis, or Intravenous Immunoglobulins (IVIg)
value.effect: Plasmapheresis or high-dose IVIg clears ravulizumab prematurely, significantly lowering therapeutic complement C5-inhibitory levels.
value.management: Concomitant use requires a supplemental dose of ravulizumab according to official prescribing weight-tiered tables.

value.drug_or_class: Neonatal Fc Receptor Blockers (FcRn Inhibitors, e.g., Efgartigimod)
value.effect: FcRn blockers promote lysosomal degradation of ravulizumab, lowering its systemic exposure and accelerating clearance.
value.management: Closely monitor for reduced complement inhibition and therapeutic failure of ravulizumab if coadministered with FcRn blockers.
